query:
SELECT pct.productId, pct.cutTypeId, ct.name as cutTypeName, p.name as productName 
FROM productCutTypes pct 
JOIN cutTypes ct ON pct.cutTypeId = ct.id 
JOIN products p ON pct.productId = p.id
ORDER BY pct.productId;
